contracts.claim: Returned debugger manifest equals durable state; copied evidence bytes match source, missing evidence is explicit, snapshots are compact, and every bundle includes a next action.
Diagnostic summaries use the newest concrete failing receipt; absent evidence is insufficient_evidence with no invented failure or proof paths; proof links are unique and bounded.
Every requested document receives a bounded successful observation or explicit error; docs_evidence.json equals the returned ordered observations.
A gateway heartbeat is durably recorded and agrees with the local accelerator registry capabilities, unlimited concurrency and workspace mapping.
Gateway routing preserves all required capabilities, selects a capable online PC, leaves ordinary work on the controller, and queues missing gateway work as a proof gap.
Lost gateway jobs are durably queued with a proof-gap explanation and cluster event rather than being declared failed.
Gateway evidence is written to the event journal and, for a job, mirrored into the cluster event history with unchanged payload.
Scores, remaining work and verification-failure deltas derive from the supplied runs; improvement requires no negative delta in any dimension.
The local deterministic pattern probe records attempts whose outcomes determine the exact count, resistance and threshold status; this is not a live model resilience claim.
Exports preserve findings and before/after/comparison evidence; report, panel and manifest exist and raw probe prompts are replaced by redaction text with their original hashes and lengths.

The generated dashboard contains parseable HTML navigation and embedded evidence rows identical to current valid proof bundles; corrupt bundles are skipped. Rendered interactions are a separate frontier.
Appending under an interprocess journal lease preserves retained prior rows and records exactly the new receipt, capped at 500 journal lines.
Updating under the journal lease matches receipt identity, preserves unrelated and malformed rows, and appends delayed missing receipts within the retention cap.
The legacy tail update is serialized with all receipt mutators and preserves preceding retained rows; it does not promise identity-based replacement.
Acknowledgement under the journal lease changes only eligible matching receipt status/time; terminal errors, unknown identifiers and corrupt rows stay unchanged.
Receipt observations under the journal lease skip unreadable rows, retain newest-last order, and filter a mission before applying the limit.
Local browser progress is recorded as delivered to control-room with unchanged event kind/message and no token in a delivery URL.
Disabled or unconfigured escalation persists an explicit skipped receipt and reason; this declaration does not claim real provider delivery.
Telegram HTML escapes all caller-controlled mission identity, body and note while retaining only the fixed approval/code markup.
Desktop commands outside the product allow-list are rejected before root resolution, policy installation, backend construction or forwarding.

proofs-b-desktop.title: PROOFS-b desktop evidence, gateway lifecycle and local delivery journals

pitfalls.failure: A generated HTML artifact or local deterministic pattern probe is mistaken for rendered desktop behavior or a real provider run.
pitfalls.recovery: Use the recorded artifact boundary; keep native UI and provider journeys in frontier until their real runtime is observed.

pitfalls.failure: Lock metadata was refreshed without capturing matching package license evidence.
pitfalls.recovery: Keep the inventory blocked and capture authoritative local package evidence before updating the bound hashes.

frontier: Live transport retries and delivery-ready mission integration remain unobserved; CORS PATCH/HTTP limit journeys require the real HTTP boundary.

Current repository build correctly rejects stale Cargo and uv lock license evidence; no provenance is invented. Hoisting/identity ambiguity, reparse/source race and canonical release CLI need independent real journeys.
Durable conversation snapshot requires an isolated backend/native journey; bundled skill byte installation alone would not cover allowed image command dispatch.

75 broad source assertions remain unmigrated across Agent, Builder, Workbench, Settings, PWA, desktop/device, provider and release features. Installed Chrome has proved the separate bounded Harness browser chapter; that does not cover these journeys. Actual NAS/public/live-app targets are outside this task authority, and no dead-code inference comes from missing source strings.
guidance: Contract checks execute at the listed production functions for direct, backend and native callers.
The registered proofs-b-desktop self-check uses a new local scratch root and no credentials, provider calls or device control.
Delivery audit mutations and observers share an interprocess journal lease; legacy tail update keeps its historical tail semantics.
Startup: neyvia verify --area proofs-b-desktop; machine receipt lists each observed contract and actual artifact path.
Feature actions and generated artifacts are the proof boundary; retained desktop/provider cases protect unobserved journeys.
